statement: Pulsed ultrasound with an implanted device and intravenous microbubbles repeatedly and safely opened the blood-brain barrier in patients with recurrent glioblastoma, demonstrated by contrast enhancement.

context.intervention: implantable pulsed ultrasound plus microbubbles before chemotherapy

measurement.effect: repeated transient opening without significant toxicity

replication.note: Reproduced by other groups with focused ultrasound since; those reports are not cited here.

limitations: access demonstrated, not a survival benefit

provenance.method: manual reasoning from the cited sources' abstracts (Crossref/Europe PMC), checked 2026-09-14; no source opened at figure level
